title: Dahir
hook: Dahir: Muhammad bin Qasim se haar
exam_points: 712 CE mein Arab senapati Muhammad bin Qasim se Sindh mein haar; Raor ke yuddh mein maara gaya.
Chachnama (Persian) mein varnan; Chach Dahir ke pita the.
Arab vijay Sindh aur Multan tak seemit raha.

mcqs.q: Muhammad bin Qasim ne Sindh par kab aakraman kiya?
